framework: SOC 2 Type I / Type II Automated Control Assessment

controls.name: Role-Based Access Control
controls.details: RBAC enforces 4 formal roles with workspace-scoped action authorization

controls.name: Data Sovereignty & Local-First Egress Prevention
controls.details: Content Security Policy strictly denies untrusted network egress (connect-src 'none')

controls.name: Prohibition of Arbitrary Dynamic Code Execution
controls.details: Zero instances of eval() or new Function() in engine src/

controls.name: Immutable Append-Only Audit Trail
controls.details: AuditLog maintains WAL-journaled immutable SQLite event store

controls.name: System Health & Prometheus Observability Probes
controls.details: Standard Prometheus exposition format and Kubernetes health/readiness probes

controls.name: Credential Broker Isolation & Secret Redaction
controls.details: Target credentials managed strictly within CredentialBroker lifecycle and redacted from output

controls.name: Deterministic Cryptographic Migration Receipts
controls.details: Every completed migration produces SHA-256 bound immutable cryptographic receipt

controls.name: Formal Trust Services Criteria Policy Suite
controls.details: All 9 SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria policies fully documented and versioned
